name: Partnership Agreement Outline
description: Creates a non-legal partnership discussion guide covering roles, equity split, decision rights, vesting, compensation, intellectual property, exit provisions, and dispute resolution for co-founders and business partners. Use when the user asks about partnership agreements, co-founder agreements, equity splits, co-founder terms, or business partnership structure. Do NOT use for legal contract drafting (recommend an attorney), incorporation decisions (use incorporation-comparison), or investor term sheets (use fundraising-narrative).
